content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGIPT Training & Placement Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 30-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGIPT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGIPT Training & Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the RGIPT Training & Placement Officer (On Contract) post is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or an equivalent postgraduate management qualification with a minimum of 55% marks and at least seven years of post-qualification professional experience in relevant fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Training & Placement Officer position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Training & Placement Officer (On Contract) post is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India rules for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Training & Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 2,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Training & Placement Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the Training & Placement Officer (On Contract) position at RGIPT.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves preliminary scrutiny, shortlisting, a presentation, and a personal interview before a selection committee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contractual basis for the Training & Placement Officer position.

faq.question: Q9. Where is RGIPT located?
faq.answer: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT) is located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open to eligible candidates, and location is not a barrier as long as the eligibility criteria are met and the application is submitted online.
